claims: The new MacBook Neo is available with an Apple education discount.
The Apple education discount lowers the base model price from $599 to $499.
The $100 discount applies to students, teachers, and staff at all levels.
The MacBook Neo features a 13-inch Liquid Retina display.
The MacBook Neo features an A18 Pro chip.
The MacBook Neo is available in multiple colors.
Students, parents, and educators can purchase via the Apple Education Store.
Education pricing applies to higher-tier storage configurations, such as the 512GB model.
